2026_02_MIN_CHI.headline: Minnesota’s backup-quarterback plan meets Chicago in a wet, pressure-heavy divisional test
2026_02_MIN_CHI.paragraph1: Minnesota starts Carson Wentz with Kyler Murray ruled out in concussion protocol and Jauan Jennings unavailable, narrowing the Vikings’ margin for negative plays. Chicago’s offense enters with Caleb Williams directing a unit capable of creating explosives, but Brian Flores’ pressure packages can force quick decisions and protection adjustments. Wentz needs the run game and clean early downs to avoid predictable dropbacks, while Williams must diagnose late movement without gifting Minnesota short fields. Wet Soldier Field conditions increase the value of ball security and special teams.
2026_02_MIN_CHI.model_rationale: Minnesota’s protection of Wentz and Chicago’s answers to disguised pressure should decide which offense limits negative plays and handles the weather-driven field-position battle more effectively.
